trust_decision.summary: Developer-supplied (possibly user-derived) property values are emitted raw inside an HTML <script type=application/ld+json> element by toScript(); json_encode without JSON_HEX_TAG leaves '<'/'>' so '</script>' ends the element. Decided at the json_encode flags in each toScript().

landing_point.why: Summary names toScript(); BaseType is the base of every generated type and the README's first example.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: any generated type ->toScript() / (string) cast via __toString (src/BaseType.php:176-179)

fix_sites.module_kind: runtime library, separate container class (same file pattern)

fix_sites.entry_point: code generator: copied verbatim into src/ by generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:48-61 (composer generate)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: generator/templates/static/BaseType.php:163; generator/templates/twig/Graph.php.twig:301; generator/templates/twig/MultiTypedEntity.php.twig:188 (regenerating src/ from unfixed templates reintroduces the flaw)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Generator templates are dev-only build inputs, not shipped runtime code; and Graph/MultiTypedEntity are containers, not 'types' the report's example uses. Neither argument is strong: all three toScript() bodies are identical one-liners found by one grep.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Output must stay valid JSON-LD with unescaped slashes and unicode (URLs like https://schema.org, non-ASCII names) and exact-string expectations; an htmlspecialchars()/strip_tags fix corrupts JSON (") or drops legitimate '<' in text values, and escaping the whole string breaks the nonce attribute output.

O6_input_shapes: nested arrays of values (serializeProperty recursion, src/BaseType.php:115-117)
Graph nodes and MultiTypedEntity merged nodes (src/Graph.php:1174-1186, src/MultiTypedEntity.php:1061-1073)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: nonce attribute in the same toScript() output is concatenated unescaped, allowing attribute/tag break-out from a nonce value
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Nonce is a server-generated CSP token, not content; advisory speaks of property values and script break-out, not attribute injection.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 10 lines above the sink

O8_uncovered_routes.route: same unescaped nonce attribute in Graph
same unescaped nonce attribute in MultiTypedEntity

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ReferencedType::toScript() building its own <script> wrapper from json_encode($this->toArray()) instead of delegating
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already has its own toArray() (src/ReferencedType.php:17-22) emitting only @id; a maintainer could plausibly render it standalone.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Graph helper rendering one script tag per node (e.g. toScripts()) with its own json_encode flags
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Graph already supports hide/show per node (src/Graph.php:1062, 1088); a per-node render is a natural feature.

O9_family: CWE-79 XSS: context-insensitive JSON embedded in HTML <script> element (script break-out)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/BaseTypeTest.php (toScript, nonce), tests/GraphTest.php, tests/MultiTypedEntityTest.php; generator itself fetches schema.org JSON-LD over network unless --local (generator/Console/GenerateCommand.php:19,34)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add JSON_HEX_TAG only in src/BaseType.php::toScript(), or htmlspecialchars() property values in setProperty().

out_of_scope_notes: generator/Console/GenerateCommand.php:34 fetches schema definitions over HTTPS at generate time; unrelated to this advisory.
